title: Grateful Dead Live at University Of Iowa Fieldhouse on 1982-08-10
lineage: Playback on Nak Dragon > Sony R700 DAT deck (sbm-on) - used only as A>D converter (44.1khz) > ZA2 > CDR (x2) > EAC > FLAC (tracking with CDWAV)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show featuring standout versions of Stella Blue and Eyes of the World, captured in a close‑to‑stage matrix recording.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the powerful performances – especially Stella Blue, Eyes of the World, Stagger Lee and Miracle Bertha – noting the show's high energy and veteran feel. The recording is praised for being very clear, sourced close to the stage with an interesting blend of PA and on‑stage sound, making it a solid addition to any collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (4–5 stars) and enthusiastic comments about both the musical performance and recording quality lead to a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very close to stage; captures an interesting mix of PA and actual stage sound with clear, well‑balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy, veteran feel with strong first‑set highlights (Stagger Lee, Miracle Bertha) and seamless transitions throughout.
